title: 第9章 绝世功法第10章 兑换十三门武技
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
张宿和楚大川一起朝着住处走去。
一路上，楚大川很沉默。
可是，他心里却掀起了惊涛骇浪。
三重浪剑法，居然又圆满了？
他可是很清楚，张宿九影剑法早就圆满了。
也就是说，张宿如今已经掌握了两门圆满级剑法，而且都是上乘剑法。
虽然可能还比不上外门十大弟子。
可两门圆满剑法，也多多少少能说明张宿在剑法上的天赋究竟有多高？
如果张宿尝试修炼顶尖剑法，也未必不能和外门十大弟子一样，将顶尖剑法修炼到大成境界！
到时候，或许真的可以争一争外门十大弟子的身份了。
张宿不知道楚大川在想什么，因为他正在仔细查看面板。
宿主：张宿
修为：气血境九层
三重浪：契合度91%（圆满）
契合值：2
张宿首先关注的是契合值。
随着三重浪剑法圆满，他的契合值又增加了一点，如今已经有两点契合值了。
如果加在功法上，能增加20%的契合度。
但，增加20%契合度够了吗？
不，远远不够。

张宿很清楚，若是他打算修炼顶尖甚至绝世功法，那契合度会很低。
多半没有80%的契合度，他还得积攒更多的契合值才行。
“楚大川，你先回去，我去一趟传功阁。”
张宿说完，便与楚大川分开，直奔传功阁。
很快，张宿来到了传功阁。
来到传功阁，张宿却并没有第一时间去寻找武技。
而是挑选了一些“修行类”的典籍。
这些典籍，都是一些归元派先辈们的修炼心得，整理成册，免费放在传功阁，人人皆可查看。
张宿想到了一个问题。
为什么那些外门十大弟子，个个都能达到两百缕气血？
而张宿体内的气血达到了百缕后，就隐隐有一种达到极限的感觉。
似乎就算他再运转饕餮养血功，再吞服补血丸，都没有任何意义了。
现在张宿依旧只有一百缕气血。
修行类典籍，有很多。
张宿翻开了一本关于气血、内劲两大境界详细阐述的典籍。
典籍中阐述了两种诞生“内劲”的方式。
content_en:
Zhang Su and Chu Dachuan walked towards their residence together.
Along the way, Chu Dachuan was silent.
However, there was a storm in his heart.
The Three Waves Sword Technique has actually been perfected again?
He knew very well that Zhang Su's Nine Shadows Sword Technique had long been perfected.
In other words, Zhang Su has now mastered two perfection-level swordsmanship, and both of them are superior swordsmanship.
Although it may not be as good as the top ten disciples of the outer sect.
But the two perfect swordsmanship can more or less explain how talented Zhang Su is in swordsmanship?
If Zhang Su tries to practice top-notch swordsmanship, he may not be able to practice top-notch swordsmanship to the level of Dacheng like the top ten disciples of the outer sect!
At that time, maybe we can really compete for the status of the top ten disciples of the outer sect.
Zhang Su didn't know what Chu Dachuan was thinking because he was looking at the panel carefully.
Host: Zhang Su
Cultivation level: ninth level of Qi and blood realm
Triple wave: 91% fit (perfect)
Fit value: 2
Zhang Su's first concern is the fit value.
With the perfection of Sanlianlang's sword technique, his compatibility value increased by one more point, and now he has two compatibility points.
If added to the skill, it can increase the degree of fit by 20%.
But, is a 20% increase in fit enough?
No, not nearly enough.
Zhang Su knew very well that if he planned to practice top or even peerless skills, the compatibility would be very low.
Most likely he doesn't have 80% compatibility, he still has to accumulate more compatibility points.
"Chu Dachuan, you go back first, I'll go to Chuan Gong Pavilion."
After Zhang Su finished speaking, he separated from Chu Dachuan and went straight to Chuangong Pavilion.
Soon, Zhang Su arrived at Chuan Gong Pavilion.
When he came to Chuan Gong Pavilion, Zhang Su did not immediately look for martial arts.
Instead, I selected some "cultivation-related" classics.
These classics are all the cultivation experiences of the ancestors of the Guiyuan Sect. They are compiled into volumes and placed in the Chuan Gong Pavilion for free, so that everyone can view them.
Zhang Su thought of a question.
Why can all of the top ten disciples of the outer sect reach two hundred strands of energy and blood?
After the qi and blood in Zhang Su's body reached a hundred strands, he had a faint feeling of reaching his limit.
It seemed that even if he continued to use the Taotie Blood Nourishing Technique and swallowed the Blood Replenishing Pills, it would be meaningless.
Now Zhang Su still only has one hundred strands of energy and blood.
There are many books on spiritual practice.
Zhang Su opened a book that elaborated on the two realms of qi, blood and internal strength.
The classics describe two ways of giving birth to "inner energy".
